rule: Every symbol on the reels is real Stacks or Bitcoin material. Nothing is drawn or imitated by hand except the Full Moon and lit-window frames, which are built from real cats. A cat with no Forever Twins twin is shown desaturated with a NOT YET FOREVER stamp.

collection.name: LEO Cats
collection.note: Registry entry: community fakfun, status live, interface v1, group G2, theme accent #12b5a6. The registry says the art host has not been recorded, so it is unrated there. Creator and mint date are not stated in the registry and are not claimed here.

tiers.method: Rarity score = information content of a cat's six traits (Background, Base, Cloth, Eyes, Hat, Mouth): the sum over traits of ln(10000 / number of cats sharing that trait value), computed across all 10,000 cats from the collection's own IPFS metadata JSON (attributes[].trait / value). Rarest 1% = Gold, next 4% = Silver, the remaining 95% split into three equal tiers (Tier I rarest of the three).
tiers.tierStringFile: art/nine-lives-art.json (tierString: one character per token id)
tiers.imageSource: Twin art: https://xtrata.xyz/inscription/mainnet/<core address>/<core name>/<xtrataId>. Untwinned cats are loaded live: Hiro token-metadata thumbnail, then IPFS gateways.

onChainRecords.what: A cat's Xtrata inscription id once twinned, otherwise its token number
onChainRecords.source: Read live from the Forever Twins registry (https://xtrata.xyz/forever-twins/data/registry.v2.json) and the LEO Cats helper contract SPV9K21TBFAK4KNRJXF5DFP8N7W46G4V9RCJDC22.leo-fakfun-xtrata (event log). 101 twins are bundled as a snapshot taken 2 Nov 2026; the count only ever rises, so the snapshot is a safe floor if Xtrata cannot be read.

live.failedRead: A failed or empty read is shown as unknown, never as no twins. While unknown, the bundled snapshot (101) keeps the cabinet open.
